title: Captain Corva Redmaw
html:
Captain Corva Redmaw is a named Pirate Captain seen at level 20–24.

Where to find Captain Corva Redmaw

  • Inside Redmaw's Grotto · seen 7×

What it can drop

  • Redmaw's Cutlass (unique Silver Scimitar, bound): 2% of kills (1 in 50), 10% from an elite (1 in 10). Heals you for 3% of the damage you deal. Half as strong against players.
  • Pell's Repeater (unique Oak Crossbow, bound): 2% of kills (1 in 50), 10% from an elite (1 in 10). Your bow and crossbow shots come 8% faster.
  • Sea Witch's Staff (unique Oak Staff, bound): 2% of kills (1 in 50), 10% from an elite (1 in 10). 8% of damage spells chill the primary target for 2.5 seconds. The chill lasts half as long on players.
  • Gear every kill: a piece from its tier, excellent or better, and a second piece 1 kill in 5.
  • Gold worth about 5 ordinary kills.
  • Enchanted: 1 kill in 100 enchants a piece (up to 9c, and only what its material can hold).
  • Elite: a boss spawns elite 1 time in 100, and an elite makes its unique 5 times as likely.

From the game’s rules and its own guide. See Unique items.
